source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current grouped sort headers draw a separator between adjacent collapsed dummy rows only when neither row is hovered, focused, current or selected. The separator opacity transition is limited to no-preference reduced-motion. Preserve keyboard/current/selection states when styling non-message headers. This adds source evidence to the distinction between dummy grouping rows and real messages.
title: Keep grouping-row decoration out of active row states
